  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  APRIL 29, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 5:31 p.m., on
  Tuesday, April 29, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA, and a
  Teleconference Site in Washington, DC 20001.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis (arrived at 5:39 p.m.)
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick (arrived at 5:32 p.m.)
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya (joined remotely at 5:39 p.m.)

  Also Present:  Interim City Manager Elaine Polachek
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  Assistant City Clerk Maria Dacanay-Wisner

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:31 p.m., with all
  (Councilmember Zwick  members present except Councilmembers Zwick and Zernitskaya, and
  arrived at 5:32 p.m.)  Mayor Pro Tem Torosis. Councilmember Hall led the assemblage in the
  Pledge of Allegiance.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember Raskin.
  (LAND
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

  LEVINE ACT  No Councilmember made Levine Act disclosures.
  DISCLOSURE
  (GC Section 84308)

  REPORT ON COUNCIL  Last week, Mayor Negrete attended the League of California Cities’ 2025
  TRAVEL  City Leaders Summit and attended sessions on housing, Proposition 36,
  public safety and transparency; and met with state legislators.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Closed Session items.
  CLOSED SESSION ONLY:

  1  April 29, 2025

  Tem Torosis arrived and  members present:
  Councilmember Zernitskaya
  joined remotely)  5.A. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code § 54957(b): consider
  public employee appointment; title: City Manager; Gov. Code §
  54957.6: conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator:
  Mayor/Personnel Director; unrepresented employee: City Manage

  This matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 8:30 p.m.
